entities.name: Carboxylic acid amidation
observations: The encoded reaction replaces a terminal carboxylic-acid C(=O)O group with C(=O)N while incorporating the second nitrogen-containing fragment.
The transformation is consistent with peptide-style amidation of a carboxylic acid by a multifunctional amine; the nitrile is expected to remain intact under standard coupling conditions.

entities.name: HATU-DIPEA amidation
observations: Plausible conditions are HATU with DIPEA in DMF or NMP, typically near room temperature; this is especially suitable for hindered amines.

entities.name: EDC-Oxyma amidation
observations: Plausible alternative conditions are EDC·HCl with Oxyma and DIPEA or NMM in DMF or DMF/DCM.

entities.name: Uronium amidation
observations: TBTU/TB​​TU-type reagent or COMU with DIPEA in DMF or NMP are plausible standard peptide-coupling systems.

entities.name: Phosphonium amidation
observations: PyBOP or PyAOP with DIPEA or NMM in DMF or NMP is a plausible alternative, particularly for a hindered amine.
